title: Our Jobs
text:
My name is Anna. I am a doctor. I work in a big hospital in the city. I help sick people every day.

My brother Tom is a teacher. He works at a school near our house. He teaches English to children. He likes his job very much.

questions.text: How does Anna probably feel about her job?
options: She is happy to help people
She does not like sick people

questions.text: Why does Tom probably enjoy his work?
options: He likes children and his job
He wants to be a doctor

vocabulary.definition: a person who treats sick people
a building where sick people receive medical care
a person who teaches people in a school

paragraph_translations: Mam na imię Anna. Jestem lekarką. Pracuję w dużym szpitalu w mieście. Każdego dnia pomagam chorym ludziom.
Mój brat Tom jest nauczycielem. Pracuje w szkole niedaleko naszego domu. Uczy angielskiego dzieci. Bardzo lubi swoją pracę.
